<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" class="k7o" role="img" aria-label="KSAB 7, News and Entertainment. Technical difficulties. Please stand by." font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <style><![CDATA[
    @font-face { font-family: 'K7 Shoulders'; src: url(/shared/fonts/big-shoulders-display.woff2) format('woff2'); font-weight: 800; font-display: swap; }
    @font-face { font-family: 'K7 Varela'; src: url(/shared/fonts/varela-round.woff2) format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
    .k7o-tall { font-family: 'K7 Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; }
    .k7o-round { font-family: 'K7 Varela', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
  ]]></style>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="k7o-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#132a5c"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0a1736"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#040a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="k7o-key" cx="0.5" cy="0.28" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6fa8ff" stop-opacity="0.22"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6fa8ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k7o-badge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe08a"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#f2c14e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c98f22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k7o-gloss" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0.45"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k7o-bar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e2503f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a8261e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="k7o-vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.45" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="k7o-sweep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9cc4ff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#9cc4ff" stop-opacity="0.1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#9cc4ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="k7o-scan" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="4" height="2" fill="#000" opacity="0.3"/>
    </pattern>
    <!-- Static from the dead line, crawling. -->
    <filter id="k7o-static" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="3" seed="7" result="n">
        <animate attributeName="seed" values="7;33;12;51;7" dur="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </feTurbulence>
      <feColorMatrix in="n" type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5" intercept="-0.16"/></feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>
    <filter id="k7o-glow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="k7o-screen"><rect width="640" height="360" rx="9"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="k7o-crawl"><rect x="96" y="320" width="544" height="22"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#k7o-screen)">
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k7o-bg)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k7o-key)"/>

    <!-- The station's three stripes, running in to the logo from both sides. -->
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="100" width="164" height="5" fill="#e2503f"/><rect x="0" y="109" width="164" height="5" fill="#f2c14e"/><rect x="0" y="118" width="164" height="5" fill="#4f9be8"/>
      <rect x="476" y="100" width="164" height="5" fill="#e2503f"/><rect x="476" y="109" width="164" height="5" fill="#f2c14e"/><rect x="476" y="118" width="164" height="5" fill="#4f9be8"/>
    </g>

    <!-- The logo: a gold set with the 7 on its screen, the call letters, and the station's line under them. -->
    <g transform="translate(5 0)">
      <g filter="url(#k7o-glow)">
        <rect x="168" y="58" width="112" height="112" rx="24" fill="url(#k7o-badge)"/>
        <rect x="168" y="58" width="112" height="112" rx="24" fill="none" stroke="#fff3c8" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
        <text class="k7o-tall" x="224" y="156" text-anchor="middle" font-size="108" fill="#0f2250">7</text>
        <path d="M180 70Q224 62 268 70V104Q224 96 180 104Z" fill="url(#k7o-gloss)" opacity="0.7"/>
      </g>
      <text class="k7o-tall" x="296" y="126" font-size="78" fill="#f4f7ff" textLength="168" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">KSAB</text>
      <rect x="296" y="138" width="168" height="1.5" fill="#f2c14e" opacity="0.7"/>
      <text class="k7o-round" x="296" y="162" font-size="13.5" fill="#f2c14e" textLength="168" lengthAdjust="spacing">NEWS & ENTERTAINMENT</text>
    </g>
    <text class="k7o-round" x="320" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#9fb6e0" letter-spacing="4.2" opacity="0.75">COLDWATER BASIN · CHANNEL 7</text>

    <!-- The message -->
    <rect x="114" y="210" width="412" height="32" rx="4" fill="url(#k7o-bar)"/>
    <rect x="114" y="210" width="412" height="1.5" fill="#ff9d8c" opacity="0.6"/>
    <text class="k7o-tall" x="320" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="27" fill="#fff6ee" letter-spacing="3.4">TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES</text>
    <text class="k7o-round" x="320" y="264" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#ffe08a" letter-spacing="6">PLEASE STAND BY
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.15;1" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </text>
    <text x="320" y="287" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#b3c2de" letter-spacing="0.4">We've lost the picture. The mast is still up.</text>
    <text x="320" y="303" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#8496b8" letter-spacing="0.4">Somebody has gone to find the one person who knows how the deck works.</text>

    <!-- The crawl: two copies of one line, each forced to 592 wide, so the loop has no seam. -->
    <rect x="0" y="320" width="640" height="22" fill="#030816" opacity="0.88"/>
    <rect x="0" y="320" width="640" height="1" fill="#f2c14e" opacity="0.5"/>
    <g clip-path="url(#k7o-crawl)">
      <g class="k7o-round" font-size="9" fill="#c9d6f0" letter-spacing="1.6">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;-600 0" dur="22s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <text x="104" y="334.5" textLength="592" lengthAdjust="spacing">PROGRAMMING RESUMES SHORTLY · NEWS AT THE TOP OF THE HOUR, IF WE'RE BACK · DON'T ADJUST YOUR SET ·</text>
        <text x="704" y="334.5" textLength="592" lengthAdjust="spacing">PROGRAMMING RESUMES SHORTLY · NEWS AT THE TOP OF THE HOUR, IF WE'RE BACK · DON'T ADJUST YOUR SET ·</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <rect x="0" y="320" width="90" height="22" fill="url(#k7o-badge)"/>
    <text class="k7o-tall" x="10" y="337" font-size="16" fill="#0f2250" letter-spacing="0.8">KSAB 7</text>
    <circle cx="76" cy="331" r="3" fill="#c9362c">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.08;1" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>

    <!-- Rolling frame-sync bar, grain, scanlines, vignette, flicker. -->
    <rect x="0" width="640" height="46" fill="url(#k7o-sweep)">
      <animate attributeName="y" values="-46;360" dur="7.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect width="640" height="360" filter="url(#k7o-static)" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k7o-scan)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#k7o-vig)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#000" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.08;0;0.04;0" dur="5.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="639" height="359" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#1e2f55" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
description: KSAB-TV channel 7 off-air card: the news and entertainment logo over TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES, with a crawl (SVG).
name: ksab7offline_card
